summary: This bill amends the annual report requirement for the Navy Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program to add information on incorporating digital infrastructure such as hardware, software, and cloud storage platforms.

scores.thoughts: The bill modifies a reporting requirement for the Navy Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program to include digital infrastructure details. It does not authorize, appropriate, increase, or reduce any government spending.
No provisions related to taxes, tax rates, deductions, or revenue collection appear in the bill.
The bill addresses only a narrow defense reporting requirement and has no connection to healthcare policy or systems.
No references to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The legislation contains nothing related to immigration, borders, or citizenship pathways.
No content touching on reproductive rights or abortion access.

While the underlying program concerns Navy shipyard infrastructure (a defense matter), the bill itself only tweaks an annual reporting requirement to add digital infrastructure metrics. It does not alter funding levels, force structure, or defense policy.
No environmental, climate, or regulatory provisions are present.
The bill does not address welfare programs, entitlements, or social services.
No education-related content or funding mechanisms.
No provisions concerning drug enforcement, decriminalization, or substance policy.
The bill has no bearing on policing, sentencing, or criminal justice reform.
No trade, tariff, or globalization measures are included.
The bill makes no changes to deficits, debt ceilings, or fiscal policy.
No language addressing LGBTQ+ protections or related civil rights.
The legislation does not involve foreign assistance or international aid.
No election administration, voting access, or electoral integrity provisions.

The bill requires reporting on incorporation of digital infrastructure and cloud platforms within a Navy program. This is a narrow administrative reporting change and does not establish new tech regulations, oversight, or privacy rules.
No labor, union, or worker-protection measures are present.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or anti-discrimination law.
